title: Munch for Me (Naked Audio)
description: It's important you realise. Making yourself better isn’t something you do for you, it’s something you do for ME. For that significant other or future woman in your life who you want to attract, to make happy. I want you to be better — really, and truly — I want you to look better, treat the world better. Make more money so supporting me is trivial! I want you to go out there to kinky munches with confidence and find yourself your own Domina. I am a romantic at heart, and think it is a lovely thing to spread a bit more kink in the world. I used to be a submissive, I can still remember the mindset. And for me still, it is always easier for me to do something hard or taxing or boring, if I am doing it FOR someone else. I have a faint suspicion many of you are the same way. InstructionsAs with all the files in the "Do It For Me Series" this one is best enjoyed if you've already listened to “Slave. Obey." and "My Sweet Boy” first. In this file I'm going to encourage you towards attending a Munch and joining a community of like-minded Kinksters. Successive files will incorporate the same base induction, "The Shibby’s Slave Contract", and will then go on to also involve things like cleaning, exercising, getting yourself promoted, being more productive, focusing, studying, getting out and meeting women with confidence… I’m going to build you up. And make you BETTER.
author: Mistress Shibby
